el.Música, pintura e intuición. Donde el so: Music, painting and intuition. Where sound turns into color.
el.Elegís la música que te emociona y la ll: You choose the music that moves you, and we bring it to the canvas. Over 4 in-person sessions we explore rhythm, color, emotion and texture, and you take home your own finished piece.
el.Bastidor de 45 × 60 cm de excelente cali: A high-quality 45 × 60 cm Di Mola stretched canvas, so you can take your piece home.
el.Acrílicos, pinceles, espátulas, marcador: Acrylics, brushes, palette knives, markers, oil pastels, gesso, watercolor pencils, charcoal, 300 g paper, India ink and an apron.
el.Playlists con distintos paisajes sonoros: Playlists with different soundscapes so you can choose the one that moves you most. Each session is an invitation to listen and turn sound into art.
el.Acompañamiento personalizado en un talle: Personalized guidance in a warm, creative studio.
el.Paternal, CABA. Cerca de Juan B. Justo y: Paternal, CABA. Near Juan B. Justo and Boyacá, 10 minutes from Villa Crespo. Weekly 2-hour sessions.
el.Consultá disponibilidad: los cupos de ca: Ask about availability: spots in each group are limited.
el.Un encuentro único de 3 horas para salir: A one-time 3-hour session to break away from your routine and end the day with a piece you created yourself. Come on your own or share it with someone you love.
el.Cupos reducidos: consultá la próxima fec: Limited spots: ask about the next date

el.Una obra pensada para tu espacio: An artwork made for your space
el.Si estás proyectando tu casa, tu cabaña: If you're designing your home, your cabin or a shop, I can create a one-of-a-kind piece, from the initial concept to the finished work, in dialogue with the architecture and its surroundings. That's how the works for Paso de los Ciervos and for the rooms of Casa Vaz came to life.
el.Soy artista visual y cantante. Mi trabaj: I'm a visual artist and singer. My work is born at the intersection of music and painting: I explore how rhythm, texture and color can translate what we hear, turning sound into gesture, into matter, into artwork.
el.Comparto esta experiencia a través de Mú: I share this experience through Música a la Obra, a workshop where I invite you to create intuitive paintings inspired by the music you choose. I also take part in live music projects, and my works are part of spaces and collections.
el.La música deja de sonar, pero sigue reso: The music stops playing, but it keeps resonating in the work.
el.Escribime por mensaje y te cuento los pr: Send me a message and I'll tell you about the upcoming groups, the next special afternoon or the available works.
